subject.title: Add a Flue delegated provider for running Crabbox jobs through Flue sandboxes

question: Should Crabbox accept Flue as a built-in delegated-run provider now, or keep it as an external-plugin/future-provider-contract design until Flue exposes a stable remote-runner path?
rationale: The issue adds a new provider and config surface, and a maintainer already closed the implementation PR while preserving this issue as the product/plugin design record.

options.title: Defer to external or future provider contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the design record until Flue has a stable native remote-runner contract and proof-backed adapter shape.

options.title: Sponsor a new built-in provider PR
options.body: Ask for a smaller replacement PR with explicit maintainer acceptance, live Flue sandbox proof, and security-boundary validation.

options.title: Decline Flue for core
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide a Flue bridge should not be a built-in Crabbox provider.

recommendation.title: Defer to external or future provider contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the design record until Flue has a stable native remote-runner contract and proof-backed adapter shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete made the latest explicit product-direction comment on the closed implementation PR while keeping this issue open.
